attributes.name: Tracy A Atkinson
attributes.blurb: Former SVP, treasurer and CFO of mutual funds at MFS Investment Management
attributes.summary: Atkinson retired in early 2020, where she held a series of leadership roles including chief compliance officer, treasurer and chief administration officer. Previously she served as SVP, treasurer and CFO of mutual funds at MFS Investment Management, and was a partner with PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.
